evidence: custom_ops.cu exports abs_forward_launcher and gt_scalar_forward_launcher with extern "C" linkage.
The contract requires abs_forward(x) -> float32 tensor same shape, and gt_scalar_forward(x, threshold=0.5) -> bool tensor same shape.
Fixed binding.cpp applies all REGISTER_BINDING registrations.

Allocate output with torch::empty_like for abs (float32) and torch::empty for gt (bool).

Call the respective launchers with raw data pointers, total element count as size_t, threshold as float, and stream.
Register both functions via pybind11 with appropriate arguments and defaults.
No CUDA kernels are implemented in the .cpp file, only launcher declarations and calls.
